jei.slime_tech_compat.info.casting: Display-only documentation for Slime Tech 0.1.44: 1,000 mB Condensed Slime cools for 200 ticks (10 seconds at 20 TPS) to make one Gel Ingot. No FE is required. The patch does not change this process. Output is produced on the tick after the cooldown reaches zero.
jei.slime_tech_compat.info.bootstrap: Smelt a Slime Block in a furnace. Slime Tech processes Dried Slime left in the furnace output into 1,000 mB Condensed Slime per item. An EMPTY BUCKET stack of exactly ONE in the fuel slot is replaced by a Condensed Slime Bucket during this processing. Put the bucket there while the furnace is still burning, before the output is processed. Right-click the Casting Mold with the filled bucket. Otherwise the liquid goes into the furnace hidden buffer (8,000 mB); extract using heat-safe pipes. Hidden-buffer cleanup on furnace removal remains outside this patch.
jei.slime_tech_compat.info.pipes: Basic Fluid Pipe rejects hot fluids, including Condensed Slime. Use Reinforced Fluid Pipe for Condensed Slime and Lava. The first Gel Ingot can be made using the furnace fuel-slot bucket route; a tank between the furnace and mold is optional.
jei.slime_tech_compat.info.mixer_clay: Mixer clay: put EXACTLY ONE Slime Ball in the center, EXACTLY ONE Slime Tech Dust in any one of the eight surrounding slots, and leave the other slots empty. Supply at least 250 mB Water. Output: one Clay block. 100 ticks at 12 FE/t (1,200 FE total). The displayed grid is one valid arrangement; larger item stacks do not match the original code.
jei.slime_tech_compat.info.mixer_radioac: Mixer Radioactive Slime: top row Slimy Coal x3, middle row Slimy Copper x3, bottom row Slimy Coal x3 (Ore Slimes items). The tank must contain EXACTLY 1,000 mB Condensed Slime. After 100 ticks at 12 FE/t, each slot loses one item and the same tank holds 1,000 mB Radioactive Slime. This display is only registered when both Ore Slimes items exist. Stacks of two or more are accepted in these nine slots; one item per slot is consumed. This differs from the exact-one clay recipe.
jei.slime_tech_compat.info.tank_guard: This patch blocks transfers when connected tanks contain different fluids, invalid contents, exceed the configured network limit, or touch an unloaded chunk. The GUI may show 0 while blocked; per-block fluid IDs and amounts are NOT erased. Separate incompatible tanks; transfers resume when valid. Do not break filled tanks without checking base-mod drop behavior.
jei.slime_tech_compat.info.pump_safety: The patch saves stable fluid registry IDs. Old dynamic numeric-only contents are quarantined, never guessed or deleted. Drain mod-fluid Pumps before upgrading if possible. blockNonWaterWorldSources=false (default) preserves original world-source pumping. When true, ALL non-water world sources, including Lava and mod fluids, are blocked; water remains allowed. This does not implement source consumption or change Fluid Handler transfers. Restart after config changes.
jei.slime_tech_compat.info.grinder: Original 0.1.44 supplies 2,000 starting FE and checks only 15 FE before charging 120 FE on completion. Optional fixGrinderEnergy=true starts new grinders empty and requires the full 120 FE before processing. Existing saved charge is preserved. The patch does NOT invent a 15 FE/t cost. Default false; restart after config changes.
jei.slime_tech_compat.info.converter_pla: 0.1.44 Energy Converter conversion modes are placeholders. This patch only documents them; it does not implement FE/RF conversion. Do not rely on the selected mode as an electrical isolation/control mechanism.
jei.slime_tech_compat.info.drain_placeho: 0.1.44 Generator DrainMode is stored/displayed but is not used by its generation logic. This patch only documents that limitation; it does not implement the missing control.
